related_entity_policy.primary_rule: A related entity alone never establishes the primary target identity.
related_entity_policy.comparison_rule: When target and related entities both have material evidence, retain for primary comparative review.
related_entity_policy.supplementary_rule: When only a recognized related entity is established, retain verified metadata or source-qualified news in the supplementary catalog.
related_entity_policy.hard_reject_rule: Only lexical noise, unrelated homonyms, navigation material, or explicit identifier conflicts are terminal rejects.
